literal: Internal enmity having feared, let one protect oneself; at the time of distress, like the enemy of clay, it will greatly destroy.
translation: Fear internal enmity and guard yourself against it. In times of distress, it will destroy you as surely as a blade slices through clay.
modern: உட்பகைக்கு அஞ்சி ஒருவன் தன்னைத் தற்காத்துக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்; அவனுக்கு ஒரு தளர்ச்சி வரும்போது, அந்த உட்பகை களிமண்ணை அறுக்கும் கருவி போல அவனை முழுமையாக அழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the severe danger posed by hidden, internal enemies. It advises one to fear such enmity and constantly guard oneself. The phrase 'மட்பகை' refers to the tool that effortlessly slices through wet clay. Just as that tool cuts the clay, an internal enemy waits for a moment of weakness to strike and completely destroy a person.
